sections.heading: OUR SERVICES
sections.subheading: From traditional tank water heaters to modern on-demand tankless systems, we handle every hot water need for homes and businesses in the Greater Waterbury area.

items.title: Water Heater Installation
items.text: Professional installation of gas, electric, and oil-fired tank water heaters. We carry top brands and size the right unit for your household or business needs.

items.title: Water Heater Replacement
items.text: Is your water heater aging out or beyond repair? We'll remove your old unit and install a new one efficiently â often the same day you call.

items.title: Water Heater Repair
items.text: No hot water, strange noises, or leaks? Our licensed plumbers diagnose and fix all water heater problems quickly to restore your hot water fast.

items.title: Tankless Water Heater Systems
items.text: On-demand tankless systems deliver endless hot water and can cut energy costs by up to 40%. We install and service all major tankless brands.

items.title: Tankless System Service & Repair
items.text: Keep your tankless system running at peak efficiency with routine descaling, maintenance, and expert repairs by certified technicians.

items.title: 24/7 Emergency Service
items.text: A failed water heater can't wait. We offer around-the-clock emergency response throughout Greater Waterbury so you're never left in the cold.
